chapters.reason: The paper explicitly describes TESS 2 as a diffusion language model that adapts an autoregressive (AR) base model, fitting the hybrid AR-diffusion paradigm.
The model operates as a diffusion language model using continuous embeddings and denoising, which aligns with the embedding-based diffusion category.
The paper focuses on instruction-following capabilities and inference-time controllability, which are key applications and capabilities of the proposed model.
